title: Belgian Interhub Document Responder Capability Statement
description: Defines the mandatory capabilities for Belgian eHealth Hubs and repositories responding to Interhub metadata discovery (getTransactionList / MHD ITI-67) and document retrieval (getTransaction / MHD ITI-68) requests via HTTP POST.

interaction.documentation: Mandatory document discovery via HTTP POST to [base]/DocumentReference/_search with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. Responding hubs SHALL support POST search. Servers MAY additionally support GET search where required for generic IHE MHD conformance.
Optional/conditional read of DocumentReference resources by ID.

operation.name: retrieve-document
operation.documentation: Document retrieval operation invoked via HTTP POST [base]/DocumentReference/$retrieve-document. Accepts a Parameters resource referencing the target DocumentReference and returns the full Document Bundle (or Binary payload) directly.

searchParam.name: patient.identifier
searchParam.documentation: Mandatory patient search parameter using national SSIN/INSS (system=https://www.ehealth.fgov.be/standards/fhir/core/NamingSystem/ssin or urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.21297.100.1.1).

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: Filters by Belgian CD-TRANSACTION code (e.g. sumehr, labresult, discharge, telemonitoring).

searchParam.name: type
searchParam.documentation: Filters by clinical document type (LOINC code).

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: Filters by document creation date range (using ge and le prefixes).

searchParam.name: author.identifier
searchParam.documentation: Filters by authoring practitioner or institution NIHDI/SSIN/CBE identifier.

resource.documentation: Retrieval of complete FHIR Document Bundles (type=document) by ID where standard GET read is supported in backend/downstream repositories.

rest.documentation: Belgian Federated Interhub Document Sharing Server (MHD ITI-67 Responder / ITI-68 Responder). Mandates HTTP POST for both metadata search and document retrieval to prevent sensitive patient data leakage in network access logs.
